summary.feature_deficiency: Feature deficiency confirmed on: Infilteration. Even with an optimistic within-class supervised ceiling, these classes cannot be separated cleanly at 1% FPR using single-flow features.
summary.algorithm_failure: IsolationForest algorithm failure confirmed on: DDoS attacks-LOIC-HTTP, DDOS attack-HOIC, DoS attacks-Hulk, Bot, SSH-Bruteforce, DoS attacks-GoldenEye. Features carry strong discriminative signal (Within-Class ceiling recall: DDoS attacks-LOIC-HTTP 99.9%, DDOS attack-HOIC 99.9%, DoS attacks-Hulk 99.8%, Bot 100.0%, SSH-Bruteforce 100.0%, DoS attacks-GoldenEye 100.0%), but IsolationForest achieves near-zero recall (<= 2.2%).
summary.iforest_inversions: Critical IForest Inversions (AUC < 0.50): DoS attacks-Hulk (AUC: 0.2180), Infilteration (AUC: 0.4137), DoS attacks-SlowHTTPTest (AUC: 0.4066), FTP-BruteForce (AUC: 0.4073). For these classes, Isolation Forest actively scores attack flows as MORE normal than legitimate traffic.
